pages.text: The $(item)Package Recipe Encoder/$ encodes recipes into $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holders/$, which then provides recipe data for machines.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To encode recipes, select a $(thing)recipe type/$.$(p)Depending on the recipe type, you can then set the inputs and outputs and their counts.$(p)Finally, put $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holders/$ inside, and press the $(thing)save button/$ to encode recipes.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: You can load recipes from encoded $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holders/$ by pressing the $(thing)load button/$.$(p)Up to 20 recipes can be encoded in $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holders/$ by selecting recipe slots at the top of the GUI.$(p)What $(l:core/package)Recipe Packages/$ are made can be previewed on the right.

pages.title: JEI Integration
pages.text: You can show all recipes applicable to the current recipe type by pressing the arrow, and you can press the $(thing)Move Items/$ button to quickly encode recipes.
